findings.description: The policy grants the full action set of four services (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on Resource "*", so the svc-deploy identity can read, modify, and delete every resource in those services rather than only what deployment requires. This violates least privilege and, via s3:*/ec2:*/lambda:*, opens broad data-exfiltration and resource-manipulation paths.

Creates a non-expiring static IAM access key for the svc-deploy user instead of using short-lived role credentials. Because the key is permanent and attached to a widely privileged principal, a single leak grants durable, broad access with no rotation or expiry guarantee.

The output surfaces the IAM access key secret material, which is persisted in Terraform state and any plan/apply logs or CI output. Anyone with access to state or pipeline logs can retrieve credential material for the svc-deploy identity.
